elsewhere.note: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,
to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
Like a madman who shoots torches, arrows, and death,
Yahweh says: “The labor of Egypt, and the merchandise of Ethiopia, and the Sabeans, men of stature, will come over to you, and they will be yours. They will go…
Yet was she carried away. She went into captivity. Her young children also were dashed in pieces at the head of all the streets, and they cast lots for her…
